property_summary: After any call to setL1BlockValues, the state variable number must equal the _number argument passed to that call. The buggy version breaks this by assigning uint64(_basefee) instead of _number, so for arbitrary _number and _basefee where they differ, number will not match _number.
change_summary: Change the assignment to number so it stores _basefee (cast to uint64) instead of _number.
